deployments_detail.use: Nvidia partnership for AI-powered music discovery, creation and fan engagement using UMG catalog; BandLab collaboration on responsible AI creator tools

SoundLabs MicDrop: a real-time AI vocal-modeling plug-in offered to UMG artists to create high-fidelity vocal models of their own voice (voice-to-voice, voice-to-instrument, speech-to-singing, language transposition) that they own and control. [SoundLabs (MicDrop)]

Endel AI-powered functional 'soundscapes': UMG artists use Endel's generative AI to turn songs/catalog into personalized wellness soundscapes (sleep, focus, relaxation) responding to inputs like time of day, weather, heart rate. First release delivered (James Blake 'Wind Down'). [Endel]

UMG-NVIDIA collaboration to use NVIDIA AI infrastructure (incl. Music Flamingo) for responsibly trained AI in music discovery, engagement/consumption, creative tools, and AI-driven business processes. [NVIDIA]

UMG-Stability AI strategic alliance to co-develop next-generation professional music-creation tools powered by responsibly trained generative AI (built on Stable Audio models trained on licensed data). [Stability AI]
UMG-Udio licensed generative-AI music creation platform (post-litigation settlement): a 'walled garden' platform trained on UMG-licensed music where fans create AI music, launching 2026. [Udio]
YouTube Music AI Incubator: UMG artists, songwriters and producers co-design and test generative-AI music tools with YouTube under agreed AI Music Principles. [YouTube / Google]
UMG-BandLab Technologies strategic AI collaboration to build creator-first, ethical AI music tools for the next generation of artists across BandLab's 60M+ user community. [BandLab Technologies]

UMG as content partner in ProRata's generative-AI attribution technology and consumer AI answer engine (Gist.ai) that attributes and compensates content owners per-use; launched with UMG among 20+ partners. [ProRata.ai]
UMG AI licensing deal with music-technology company KLAY: KLAY's foundational AI music model trained on/licensing UMG catalog to power a new generation of licensed generative music. [KLAY Vision]

UMG-Spotify licensing deal enabling Spotify Premium users to generate licensed AI-driven covers and remixes of participating UMG artists' songs, with artists/songwriters sharing in AI-generated value. [Spotify]

SoundPatrol neural fingerprinting: neural-embedding audio-analysis system (Stanford-originated) deployed with UMG and Sony to detect copyright infringement in music, including covers, remixes and fully/partly AI-generated works, by identifying influence of original human-created music. [SoundPatrol]
UMG appointed a Chief Data Officer (Hannah Poferl) to lead global data/AI strategy leveraging data and AI for audience development, superfan engagement and talent discovery. [none]
